data_source: synthetic mock data; not real traffic performance
protocol: Chronological 80/20 split; fixed training; identical rolling origins for all methods; scaler fitted on train only.
limitations: One synthetic day cannot establish generalization.
Overlapping forecast windows are not independent samples.
No tuning or model selection performed on test data.
Seasonal naive uses a one-hour lag, not a daily cycle.
MAPE excludes zero targets; all-zero targets are reported as zero by the existing metric helper.
